info.description: Backend API for the vLearn2 English-learning app.

cidUsername.description: Login username. Letters + digits only, with at least 2 letters and at least 2 digits (e.g. kky1206, ks10, ksg19970890).

expiresIn.description: Access-token expiry in seconds from now

displayName.description: Display name to derive initials from

scenarioId.description: Scenario id; omit for free talk

newPassword.description: New plain-text password chosen by the admin. Must satisfy the same length-only rule as user sign-up (≥ 6 chars).

machineId.description: Opaque device fingerprint from native lib.

userId.description: App user UUID to bind the license to.
